issues.title: Update react to 18
issues.body:
@lilitkarapetyan is currently implementing clustered map icons

She can't use the newest version of react-leaflet-cluster, because of react-leaflet dependencies.

She can't use the newest version of react-leaflet, because of react depenedencies.

So, we should try updating to `react-18` in a branch off `develop`, and testing it.
